steps.text: Talk to Emelio in Outer Fortis at the south-eastern entrance of Civitas illa Fortis to start the quest.
Talk to the Spice Merchant in the Bazaar in the middle of Civitas illa Fortis about the missing delivery.
choices: I'm here about a missing delivery.
Could I have a look at that locked box?

steps.text: Submit the code.
Reset the code.
Click 2.
Click 5.
Click 4.
Click 6.
Enter the code 2546 to unlock the box.
Figure out the correct code to unlock the box of spices.
Talk to Alba in the farmhouse west of Civitas illa Fortis.
Head west from the farm and enter the Wolf Den, prepared to kill the Dire Wolf Alpha.
Kill the Dire Wolf Alpha. Use Protect from Melee to avoid most damage. His pups deal ranged damage.
Exit the wolf den, then head back to Alba in the farmhouse west of Civitas illa Fortis.
Return to Alba in the farmhouse west of Civitas illa Fortis to tell them about the Dire Wolf Alpha's demise.
Return to Emelio in Outer Fortis at the south-eastern entrance of Civitas illa Fortis to find the perfect ratio of ingredients for the kebab.
Tell Emelio the recipe is perfect.
Adjust the recipe with Emelio. Four portions of meat, two portions of salad, one portion of spice, and three portions of sauce.
Configure the kebab recipe with Emelio.
Talk to Renata to have them test your test kebab.
Figure out the correct ratio of meat, salad, spice, and sauce by talking to the kebab connoisseurs outside then give the final recipe to Emelio.
Return to Emelio with news of your kebab success!
Head into the Fortis Colosseum and talk to Lelia about kebab sales.
Head into the Fortis Colosseum, then into the southern room and talk to Lelia about kebab sales.
Talk to Lelia after letting her taste your test kebab.
Head into the Fortis Colosseum, ready to fight the Minotaur.
Talk to Lelia in the southern room, ready to fight the Minotaur.
Fight the Minotaur. Protect from Melee to avoid most damage. When it shouts Moo! switch to Protect from Magic for one attack.
Talk to Emelio to get another test kebab.
Talk to Emelio to get another test kebab before you can fight the Minotaur.
Talk to Lelia in the southern room, ready to fight the Minotaur again.
Head into the Fortis Colosseum, ready to fight the Minotaur again.
Talk to Lelia in the southern room of the Fortis Colosseum after defeating the Minotaur.
Head into the Fortis Colosseum and talk to Lelia.
Exit the colosseum, then return to Emelio in Outer Fortis at the south-eastern entrance of Civitas illa Fortis and tell him about your success.
Return to Emelio in Outer Fortis at the south-eastern entrance of Civitas illa Fortis and tell him about your success.

generalRecommended: 43+ Prayer to use Protect from Melee and Protect from Magic
